cli.usage:
tend — Claude Code / Codex sessions and the tasks agents run on your machines: favorite, search, resume, dispatch

  tend                       default UI (TEND_UI=fzf|tui)
  tend tui | tend fzf         pick a front end
  tend add                   read the JSON produced by the /tend skill from stdin
  tend list [query]          list favorites (--json / --line)
  tend sessions [query]      list every session on this machine, favorited or not (--json)
  tend grep <keywords> [query]  search the messages of every session; filter tokens pick which (--json / --limit)
  tend show <id>             one record (--json)
  tend preview <id>          render the preview block
  tend open <id>             the TUI on one session, right pane focused (also sessions the lists hide)
  tend status <id> todo|doing|done
  tend done <id>             = status done
  tend archive|unarchive <id>
  tend favorite|unfavorite <id>  favorite / unfavorite (record kept)
  tend pin|unpin <id>        keep the transcript with a hard link
  tend edit <id>             edit title / tags / summary in $EDITOR
  tend rm <id|session id>    move a session's files to the trash (-y skips the prompt) (alias: delete)
  tend trash                 list the trash (--json; --restore <id|session id>; --purge drops expired, --purge --all empties it after a prompt, -y skips)
  tend mv <old dir> <new dir>  move a project: rewrite cwd in its sessions (-y skips the prompt) (alias: move)
  tend fix [dir] [query] [n…]   sessions whose directory moved: list (default), move with numbers / session ids / all (--to picks the target)
  tend clean [dir] [query] [n…] unrecoverable sessions: list (default), trash with numbers / session ids / all
  tend resume <id>           resume (--dry-run / --no-herdr; --fork starts a copy)
  tend handoff <id>          print a handoff pack for a new session (--to claude|codex starts one that reads it)
  tend today | tend week        what you worked on, by project: sessions, files written, commits (--json; a query narrows it)
  tend doctor                health check (--compact compacts the data file)
  tend hosts                 the configured machines and when their lists were last fetched
  tend hosts check [host…]   probe each machine: ssh, tend version, CLIs, CJK round trip, read speed (--timeout)
  tend hosts add <name> <ssh alias>  add a machine (--tend path, --wsl distro | --docker container, --shell), then check it
  tend hosts rm <name…>      remove machines and their cached lists
  tend hosts install <host>  build tend from this checkout and install it there, in WSL or a container too (--os / --arch / --src / --dry-run; --server adds tend-server)
  tend hosts clear [host…]   forget cached lists (all hosts by default)
  tend task add <title>      a task for an agent (--brief s | --brief-file f, --dir, --machine, --agent, --project, --parent, --after, --backlog, --workflow name|none)
  tend task [list]           open tasks and their last run (--all, --json); show <id> | edit <id> … | done | reopen | cancel <id> | start <id> (with its subtree) | move <id> --parent p --after a,b
  tend task plan <id>        a planner drafts its subtasks (--agent, --machine); tend task draft <id> shows it (--save f | --apply | --discard)
  tend task merge <id>       merge its branch into its parent's again, once a conflict was resolved there
  tend task gate <id>        decide a workflow's human gate: --pass | --rework "what to change"
  tend task message <id> <text>  words for a task: into its running run, as the reply that continues its last run, else onto its workpad (--mode steer|after|interrupt)
  tend run start <task>      run a task on a machine (--machine, --agent, --runner background|herdr, --wait)
  tend run [list]            runs (--task, --all, --json); stop <run> | abandon <run> | show <run> | logs <run> [-f]
  tend run continue <run> <text>  reply to a run that waits, in its session (--file f, --session <id> for any session, --wait)
  tend run answer <run>      answer what a running run waits on: --allow | --deny [--message m] | --answer [QUESTION=]ANSWER
  tend run send <run> <text> a message for a running run (--file f)
  tend run ask|note <text>   inside a run: ask the user, or report progress, to the run's state (note --pr <url>: its pull request)
  tend run plan <file|->     inside a planner's run: check and hand in its plan
  tend run verdict pass|rework|blocked <summary>  inside a run: how a review or test stage judges the work
  tend inbox                 runs that need you on every machine: waiting, asked, failed, quiet; longest waiting first (--json)
  tend agent list            agent profiles: built-in claude / codex / fake, config.agents and definitions
  tend agent defs            agent definitions; import <file.md> [--project p] | export <name> [-o f] | check <file.md> | rm <name> | share <name> --users --projects --all --view | leave <name> | transfer <name> --project p
  tend machine list          this machine and the configured hosts as the coordinator sees them (--connect)
  tend journal verify|repair check the coordinator's journal (--json); repair cuts a torn or bad last line after a copy (-y)
  tend service               stay the coordinator: dispatch and watch runs, answer clients on the socket
  tend-server                mode 2 is its own program: the coordinator for nodes and clients with tokens (tend-server help)
  tend login [URL]           sign in through a browser (device code); saves the token and coordinator url (default: config.coordinator.url)
  tend node --connect URL    mode 2: this machine as a node of the server (--token-file; needs node.allow_dirs)
  tend node install-service  start that node at login: LaunchAgent / systemd --user / scheduled task (--connect, --token-file, --print; uninstall-service)
  tend rpc                   answer one protocol request from stdin (--stdio: until stdin closes); run over ssh
  tend version               print the version
  tend install-skill         install the /tend skill into Claude and Codex
  tend uninstall-skill       remove the /tend skill (only the symlinks)
  tend install-hook          let Claude Code tell tend when it asks you something (hooks in settings.json; tend uninstall-hook removes them)
  tend shell-init [zsh|bash] [--key ctrl-g] [--ui fzf|tui]  print shell code binding a key to tend fzf: put eval "$(tend shell-init zsh)" in .zshrc

cli.server.moved: the server is its own program now: tend-server (tend-server help)
cli.server.usage:
tend-server — mode 2: the tend coordinator served to nodes and clients that hold a token, with the Web UI

  tend-server --listen addr  serve (--tls-cert/--tls-key; --plain in a container behind a forwarder)
  tend-server token [list]   tokens; add --node <name> | --client <name> [--owner <user>] prints a new one; rm <name> revokes it; rebind <name> lets a node token move to another machine
  tend-server admin [list]   users and who may sign in; add <email|domain|provider:user> [--role], rm, invite [--role r] [--project p --access participant|reader], disable|enable <id>, role <id> <role>, audit
  tend-server import [file]  copy a mode 1 journal (coord/events.jsonl) into the database; the server is stopped
  tend-server export [-o f]  write the database as a journal that tend journal verify reads
  tend-server backup [dir]   copy the database, coord/id, tokens and config into a new directory
  tend-server db check       check the database: quick_check, seq order, every envelope applies
  tend-server version        print the version
